text: Artificial intelligence is becoming part of our daily lives, so ethics in AI matters more than ever. One major problem is bias: if AI learns from unfair data, it can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or even medical care. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, because AI systems often collect and use personal information. People should know how their data is used and feel safe. Transparency helps here, since we need to understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create rules that protect people and build trust in technology.
